FeinwerkDashboardSharing.PluginDescription: Share a dashboard with your team. Colleagues subscribe to a read-only copy that updates itself whenever you change the original.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ShareButtonTooltip: Share this dashboard with other users. They get a read-only copy that follows your changes.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ImportButtonTooltip: Import a dashboard that another user has shared with you.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ShareToAll: All users who can see one of your websites
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ShareUsersAdminOnly: Only admins can pick users from a list. Enter the logins below instead.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.NoShares: You have not shared any dashboard yet.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.NoAvailableShares: No shared dashboards are available to you.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.SyncedNotice: This dashboard is synced from %s and is read-only. The owner's changes appear when you reopen it.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.SubscribedDone: Subscribed. The dashboard was added to your dashboards.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ShareError: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerIntro: With the free Feinwerk Connector you install, update and license Feinwerk plugins right inside Matomo.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerInstallText: Matomo downloads the connector from its Marketplace, installs it and then activates it.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerActivateText: The connector is already installed but not activated yet.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerPasswordNote: As with every plugin install, Matomo first asks for your password if you have not entered it recently.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerManual: This Matomo cannot install plugins from its Marketplace by itself. To install the connector by hand:
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerManualStep2: Unzip it and put the folder FeinwerkMarketplaceConnector into the plugins directory of your Matomo.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerManualStep3: Activate the connector under Administration, Plugins.

FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerConsole: The connector is already installed, but plugin administration is switched off in this Matomo. Activate it on the command line:
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerPhp: The Feinwerk Connector needs PHP %s or newer. Once your server runs it, you can install the connector here.
FeinwerkDashboardSharing.ConnectorInstallerWordPress: In Matomo for WordPress the Feinwerk Connector is installed as a WordPress plugin: open Matomo Analytics, Marketplace in WordPress and search for Feinwerk.
